title: Classifying Strong Linear Key Schedules for Reflection Ciphers
summary: Security is proved for one alternating two-key schedule, but a complete classification of strong linear schedules using two independent master keys remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine a complete classification of all strong linear key schedules for reflection ciphers that use two independent master keys.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptography concerning key-schedule security in reflection ciphers.
scope.unresolved_remainder: A complete classification of all strong linear key schedules for reflection ciphers using two independent master keys.

progress.summary: The source presents this as an open question in its future-work discussion, after results for one alternating two-key schedule. It identifies the broader classification of strong linear schedules using two independent master keys as unresolved.
citation_labels: Tim Beyne et al., Provably Secure Reflection Ciphers
